title: AI Expert Marketplace Story Frames on a Laptop
whatItIs: A tilted photo of a laptop showing four vertical story frames for an AI expert marketplace: a white frame with gradient-word headline and a robot mascot, a black frame with a blank card, a white frame with orbiting expert avatars around a brand mark and a photo frame of a woman in glasses with arcs and a mascot chip.
whatItMeans: Colourful gradient words and a friendly robot make an AI service feel human, and showing the frames in a working file adds authenticity.
techniques: Gradient colour on key headline words
Robot mascot as a recurring character
Orbiting avatars around a brand mark
Curved colour arcs around a photo
Photo of a screen in a warm cafe setting

vocabulary.definition: A word filled with a colour gradient in a headline.
Items arranged in rings around a centre.
A photograph of a design on a monitor.
